activity.notes: Tshombe's continuous premiership is represented under the Democratic Republic of the Congo from the 1 August 1964 constitutional state-name change until President Joseph Kasa-Vubu dismissed him on 13 October 1965.

sources.title: Moïse Tshombe — Dictionary of African Biography reference record
sources.citation_text: The biographical authority record cites the Dictionary of African Biography and records Tshombe's premiership from 10 July 1964 to 13 October 1965.

sources.title: Constitution of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (1964)
sources.citation_text: The constitution establishing the Democratic Republic of the Congo was promulgated on 1 August 1964 and bears Tshombe's signature as Prime Minister.
